messages:
reshma: Hi team — PR #8421 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421) is blocked on design review. Linked design doc / RFC: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/RFC-2026-kv-routing. This touches request routing, fallback tiers, and rollout policy. Need architecture eyes before merge — can someone from platform take a quick look? cc @alex @brad

alex: on it, thanks. quick q: does this change any public SLOs or only internal routing latency? and what's the rollback path?

reshma: Short answers: SLOs remain the same at the customer-facing level (no quota/slo bump), but p95 latency could increase ~3–7ms under long-seq tails for certain models. Rollback plan is immediate feature-flag flip + router route back to model-v1. Deployment/rollback section in the RFC has details.

brad: I can review by EOD. Two requests up front: 1) add a unit/integration test for the new routing predicate, 2) clarify canary duration in the PR description. Also include the exact flag name you plan to use.

reshma: Thanks. Canary plan: 2h at 5% traffic, then 30m at 25%, then full. Feature flag: infra.routing.kv_fallback_v2. I pushed a lightweight table-driven test to the branch (tests/routing/test_kv_fallback.go). Snippet for PR: ```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 5
    duration: 2h
  - percent: 25
    duration: 30m
```

olivia: FWIW security review not required for this change, but please add an audit-log entry for fallback activations. small ops ask: add a note in the rollout playbook about who to contact if the canary shows model-quality regressions. :thumbsup:

kai: Noted. Also double-check quantization compat between variants — fallback uses model-v1-small; if embeddings/kv format differs we could hit parse errors. I'll run a quick smoke.

arch-bot: Automated notice: RFC-2026 last edited 2293450000, status: under-review. Linked PRs: #8421. Please ensure RFC checklist items 2,3,7 are satisfied before arch approval.

reshma: Great — I'll update the PR with the explicit canary block, add the audit-log entry, and paste the rollback command in the description. Will ping once tests are green.

brad: Ping me after the update and CI pass, will do final approve if tests + canary are in the PR.

alex: thanks — if no blockers after brad's review we can schedule merge during the usual release window tomorrow morning.
